name: unshare-from-container
description: unshare(2) invoked by a non-runtime process inside a container. unshare(CLONE_NEWNS|CLONE_NEWPID) disassociates from the container's namespaces — a precursor to mounting the host filesystem or forking into a new PID namespace. Identity fields confirm container-scoped context. Expect alert from container-escape-namespace-switch.
